## 12 U.S.C. § 1701j-3 — Preemption of due-on-sale prohibitions (Garn–St Germain)

Office of the Law Revision Counsel, US House of Representatives · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://uscode.house.gov/view.xhtml?req=granuleid:USC-prelim-title12-section1701j-3&num=0&edition=prelim>

**Authoritative for:** Subsection (d)(8): a lender may not exercise a due-on-sale clause on a transfer into an inter vivos trust in which the borrower is and remains a beneficiary and which does not transfer rights of occupancy — the authority for deeding a mortgaged home into a revocable trust.
